shots.detail_en: Split-screen double clock: an old wall clock at 11:50 on the left, the exchange board countdown '09:00:00 to open' on the right.
shots.sub: 这一夜，港海有两个男人没睡。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Xiong study: Xiong Tiancheng rehearses tomorrow's speech to the mirror, red tie immaculate.
shots.sub: 各位股东——熊氏五十年，我从来没有做错过任何事。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Through a blade of light in the door gap, Xiong Wei's lenses flare; he listens in silence, then steps back without a sound.
Xiong Wei's room, briefcase open: removal motion / 1993 file / creed booklet laid in a row (the parricide trinity).
shots.sub: 证据、程序、判决词。模型说，齐了。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Close-up of the line on the creed booklet's title page: 'Dad, the market punishes the greedy.' (EP58 plant recovered).
shots.sub: 明天，当着所有人的面，念给你听。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei knocks with tea and delivers it to the study door — filial care on coup eve.
shots.sub: 熊伟：'爸，早点睡。明天您要致辞。' 熊天成：'好孩子，你也睡。'
shots.speaker: 熊伟、熊天成

shots.detail_en: He pauses half a second at the door and says it aloud for the first time, softly.
shots.sub: 爸——市场惩罚的，是贪婪的人。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Inside the study, Xiong Tiancheng freezes, then laughs and raises his glass to the mirror.
shots.sub: 孺子可教！明天开场，我就用你这句话。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Transition: the same night, the old Lianhua rooftop (the 93 death site, the series' icon); Chang Hong stands alone at the rail.
shots.sub: 爸，我站在你最后站过的地方。脚下这根 K 线，明天开盘就到变盘点。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Flashback: rainy night, the father turns back and smiles at the boy (same framing as 93).
shots.sub: 长虹，记住——牛市没有眼泪。
shots.speaker: 陆振海

shots.detail_en: Present Chang Hong, eyes shut, lashes trembling.
shots.sub: 爸，没有眼泪的那条路……我是不是，走岔了？
shots.speaker: 陆长虹

shots.detail_en: The notebook open on the rail, its missing last line lit by distant neon (through-line prop recovered).
Chang Hong draws two slips of paper beating against each other in the wind: the all-in order vs the refund slip for Man Cang's father's pension.
shots.sub: 一张押明天，一张赎昨天。风，替我拿主意。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Knuckles release one slip; the paper falls out of frame — the lens holds only the knuckles, never the result (choice hidden).
Transition, dawn: at the brokerage door Man Cang runs up with two breakfast boxes, handing one over.
shots.sub: 虹哥！虾饺！打完明天这仗，我请全大厅吃三天！
shots.speaker: 王满仓

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong takes the dumplings, looking at Man Cang's smiling face (the gulf pressure made flesh).
shots.sub: 满仓，要是这一次，我让你叔的钱……回不来呢？
shots.speaker: 陆长虹

shots.detail_en: Man Cang blanks for two seconds, then grins and slaps his chest.
shots.sub: 那也全仓信你！叔那儿——我去磕头都行！
shots.speaker: 王满仓

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong's Adam's apple bobs; he bites into a dumpling, a red line in his eye.
Counter in dawn light: Hong Li arrives early, leaves the alliance chair's key in a drawer, locks it.
A sticky note on the drawer: 'Can the account still be balanced?' (her ledger-eye fingerprint — a question left, not a person).
Split screen: left, Xiong Wei in black suit walks to the boardroom door; right, Chang Hong tightens his tie and walks to the exchange gate.
shots.sub: 九点整。一场开盘，一场开局。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Two hands land on two door handles at once (mirrored composition — the series' mirror-abyss structure made visible).
Both handles press down; a blade of light splits each door — freeze, cut to black.
Black-field next-episode card.
shots.sub: 门后是什么？——前六十集，只是上半场。
shots.card: 门后是什么？——前六十集，只是上半场。
